overview: The council approved a joint press release outlining the timeline and cost review for the Medford High School project, authorized capital and stabilization funds for municipal facility repairs and the police chief search, and received updates regarding Cataldo Ambulance operations. The council also tabled a supplemental appropriation to restore the law department budget and referred a fire department drone surveillance policy to committee.

items.title: Winter Preparedness and Veterans Day Recognition
items.summary: The council recognized Veterans Day and approved a resolution inviting residents to upcoming community winter clothing giveaways and preparedness clinics.

items.title: Committee Report: Public Works and Facilities
items.summary: Approved the committee report on private ways maintenance, legal counsel requests regarding maintenance budgeting, and snow plowing liability.

items.title: Grant of Location: Fulton Street and Brogan Road Gas Main
items.summary: Approved a grant of location with engineering conditions for National Grid to replace 1,665 feet of gas main along Fulton Street and Brogan Road.

items.title: Zoning Amendment: Vacant and Foreclosing Properties
items.summary: Approved the Community Development Board's recommendation to delete Section 94-7.5 from the zoning ordinance effective August 4, 2027, to coincide with the effective date of the new general vacant building ordinance.

items.title: Resolution on Veterans Department Vacancy
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a staffing update for the Veterans Services Department, with the chief of staff confirming interim coverage and upcoming candidate interviews.

items.title: Medford High School Project Press Release and Timeline
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution authorizing a joint press release with the School Committee detailing project timeline milestones, upcoming public forums, and financial vetting ahead of a February 2027 presentation. Multiple residents spoke during public comment to voice concern over the estimated project cost and tax impact.

items.title: Resolution on Cataldo Ambulance Operations and Ownership
items.summary: Approved a resolution inquiring into the contractual impacts of any potential sale of Cataldo Ambulance, following statements from company leadership clarifying that no sale is imminent and addressing neighborhood parking concerns.

items.title: Stabilization Appropriation: Police Chief Search
items.summary: Approved an appropriation of $35,000 from the General Stabilization Fund to compensate recruitment consulting firm MGT for the ongoing police chief search.

items.title: Capital and Stabilization Appropriations: Municipal Facilities
items.summary: Approved appropriations of $85,000 for a recreation center rehabilitation study, $71,000 for fire headquarters weatherproofing, and $24,476.44 for water damage remediation at the former police station.

items.title: Supplemental Appropriation: FY2027 Law Department Budget
items.summary: Tabled a request to appropriate $269,295.81 to fully restore the FY2027 law department budget prior to the upcoming tax classification hearing.

items.title: Fire Department Drone Surveillance Policy
items.summary: Referred the fire department's unmanned aerial system operating policy and surveillance report to the Public Health and Community Safety Committee.

items.title: Public Participation: Sturgis Street Traffic Safety
items.summary: Heard a petition from residents regarding severe speeding and wrong-way driving at Sturgis and Morgan streets, with councilors agreeing to coordinate an on-site audit with traffic officials.
